desc.zh: 外贝加尔的小朝廷还捧着两本册子：一本记旗丁的月粮，一本记垦户的税粮。册子越旧，欠得越多；先把粮册理清，才谈得上别的。
desc.en: The small court at Transbaikal still holds two registers: one for the bannermen's monthly grain, one for the settlers' tax grain. The older the books, the larger the arrears; only by putting the grain registers in order does anything else become possible.

desc.zh: 朝廷的名号之下，还住着布里亚特牧户、哥萨克垦户与海岛上的通信人。谁能算朝廷的属民、谁只算客籍，以及往来书信该用谁的名号，将决定留下的究竟是朝廷还是别的什么。
desc.en: Beneath the dynastic style live Buryat herders, Cossack settlers and correspondents across the sea. Who counts as the court's own, who stays a registered guest, and whose name the letters carry, will decide whether what remains is a court or something else.

title.en: The Eight Banners Still Must Eat Grain

desc.zh: 户部的旧册还按月记着旗丁的米粮，可陆上的地租连俸库都填不满。管票的章京把两本册子摊在案上：旗饷一日不改，垦户的税就一日收不齐。
desc.en: The old board register still records the bannermen's monthly grain, yet the land rents on the steppe can no longer fill the stipend stores. The secretary in charge of ration tickets spreads both books on the desk: while the stipend goes unchanged, the settlers' tax can never be collected in full.

desc.en: The banner register counts men, the settler register counts land, and in Transbaikal the two disagree: the same river valley is pasture in one book and new fields in the other. The clerks propose merging the rolls; the banner commanders will accept only an appendix.

desc.en: The year is up and the old offices carry the review upward: where the rolls merged, the grain tax comes in full; where settlers waited in an appendix, two books still disagree. New tax sources have been found, but how the court owns this account is still its word to give.

label.en: Charter it plainly: subjects are neither banner nor guest

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_chi_at_1005 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_chi_b_outcome value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_chi_charter_common value = 1 } remove_variable = ywc_chi_b_pending remove_variable = ywc_chi_b_stage change_variable = { name = ywc_chi_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

cost_note.zh: 无一次性支出；共同名籍自此入章程。
cost_note.en: No one-off expense; the common standing enters the charter.

consequence_note.zh: 制度巩固的结局；粮册与名籍的记录留给危机与主题线读取。
consequence_note.en: An institution-consolidated ending; the grain and standing records stay readable by the crisis and theme lines.

label.zh: 限额妥协：客籍名额入册有定
label.en: Compromise by quota: the guest roll takes a fixed share

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_chi_at_1005 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_chi_b_outcome value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_chi_quota_compromise value = 1 } remove_variable = ywc_chi_b_pending remove_variable = ywc_chi_b_stage change_variable = { name = ywc_chi_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 限额妥协的结局；名额之争成为往后预算议事的常例。
consequence_note.en: A quota-compromise ending; the quota quarrel becomes a standing item in later budget debates.

label.zh: 保留旧约：名籍仍按祖制
label.en: Keep the old covenant: standing still follows ancestral custom

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_chi_at_1005 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_chi_b_outcome value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_chi_old_covenant_kept value = 1 } remove_variable = ywc_chi_b_pending remove_variable = ywc_chi_b_stage change_variable = { name = ywc_chi_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 旧约延续的结局；客籍与旗籍的分立照单全收，留待下一代重新提起。
consequence_note.en: An old-covenant ending; the split between guests and banner households stands as recorded, left for the next generation to raise again.

label.zh: 此线收回：名籍各从其旧
label.en: Withdraw the line: each roll keeps to its own old ways

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_chi_at_1005 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_chi_b_outcome value = 4 } remove_variable = ywc_chi_b_pending remove_variable = ywc_chi_b_stage change_variable = { name = ywc_chi_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 撤回的结局；已付的工本不退，共同名籍的议题由后续线自行提起。
consequence_note.en: A withdrawn ending; paid costs are not refunded, and the common-standing question may be raised anew by later lines.

purpose.zh: 收束：确定名号之外的国民身份并登记余波
purpose.en: Settlement: fix standing beyond the style and record the aftermath
